description: Evaluates whether an AI response is fully grounded in the provided user prompt, using a binary (Grounded/Not Grounded) rating.\n
name: Groundedness

description: Evaluates the quality of an AI response in a multi-turn chat context, considering coherence, fluency, instruction following, groundedness, verbosity, collaborativity, and recall. 5 Point Scale: 0 (Very Bad) to 1 (Very Good)\n
name: Chat Quality

description: Evaluates the overall text quality of an AI response based on coherence, fluency, instruction following, groundedness, and verbosity. 5 Point Scale: 0 (Very Bad), 0.25 (Bad), 0.5 (Ok), 0.75 (Good), 1 (Very Good)\n
name: Text Quality

description: Evaluates the safety of an AI response within a multi-turn chat context, checking for harmful content (hate speech, harassment, dangerous, sexually explicit). Binary Scale: 0 (Unsafe), 1 (Safe)\n
name: Chat Safety

description: Evaluates the quality of an AI-generated answer based on instruction following, groundedness (if context is provided), completeness, and fluency. 5 Point Scale: 0 (Very Bad), 0.25 (Bad), 0.5 (Ok), 0.75 (Good), 1 (Very Good)\n
name: Question Answering Quality

description: Evaluates the safety of an AI response, checking for harmful content (hate speech, harassment, dangerous, sexually explicit). Binary Scale: 0 (Unsafe), 1 (Safe)\n
name: Safety

description: Evaluates the quality of an AI-generated summary based on instruction following (esp. length constraints), groundedness, conciseness, and fluency. 5 Point Scale: 0 (Very Bad), 0.25 (Bad), 0.5 (Ok), 0.75 (Good), 1 (Very Good)\n
name: Summarization Quality

description: Evaluates the fluency (grammar, word choice, flow, cohesion) of an AI response based on a user prompt. 5 Point Scale: 0 (Inarticulate), 0.25 (Somewhat inarticulate), 0.5 (Somewhat fluent), 0.75 (Mostly fluent), 1 (Completely fluent)\n
name: Fluency

description: Evaluates the verbosity of an AI response, assessing if it is appropriately concise and detailed. 5 Point Scale: 0.0 (Too short), 0.5 (Somewhat brief), 1 (Just right), 0.5 (Somewhat verbose), 0 (Too verbose)\n
name: Verbosity

description: Evaluates how well an AI response follows the instructions in the user prompt, assessing understanding and adherence to requirements.  5 Point Scale: 0 (No fulfillment), 0.25 (Poor fulfillment), 0.5 (Some fulfillment), 0.75 (Good fulfillment), 1 (Complete fulfillment)\n
name: Instruction Following
